name: github
sibling_note: GitHub publishes github.com's public API and GitHub Enterprise Cloud's API as separate spec files in the same repo. An endpoint that moves from one to the other looks identical to a removal if only api.github.com.json is watched -- checking siblings tells the two apart. GHES version-specific spec files exist too (ghes-3.x) but aren't watched here yet.
watched_files_note: Stand-in for a real customer repo -- there isn't one yet, since Tremor has no users. Points monitor.py's patch step at the same blind test file phase 3 used, so a live check exercises the full pipeline end to end.
